## 1. Urban Arrow enters the longtail cargo e-bike market in US with its new Breeze

- 分類：品牌新品｜全球
- 摘要：Urban Arrow has spent the last 14 years building a reputation around front-loading cargo bikes, becoming one of the biggest names in the family cargo bike world. Now the Dutch company is branching out into an entirely new category with the launch of the Urban Arrow Breeze, bringing its first-ever longtail electric cargo bike to the North American market.

## 2. Rivian’s long-delayed ALSO e-bike is only delayed a little bit longer

- 分類：品牌新品｜全球
- 摘要：The wait for Rivian’s first electric bike just got a little bit shorter. After months of delays, ALSO has informed reservation holders that they’ll finally be able to place pre-orders for the company’s highly anticipated TM-B electric bike starting August 18. It’s welcome news for the unknown number of people who put down reservations, though it’s hard to ignore just how far the timeline has slipped.
